disposition: Typed change payloads exist for counters, time-series (segment summaries), and attachments (content-addressed metadata) and round-trip through replay and live delivery under bounded, acknowledged, checkpointed subscriptions with at-least-once identifiable duplicates and document-body refusal; the other family kinds never mint payloads (pinned by test rather than silently dropped), and per-family include/filter delivery is untested.
